what: Mistake: accepted the reading of job 20261023-234149-jcd2 (retry of nvbb) that edits the shared verifier prompt, without checking prompt budgets: the study verifier composes that frame at 1296 of 1300 tokens, so any addition fails the budgets test; the producer looped on it until its 1800 s deadline (two failed attempts, about 80 minutes).
why: The reader or planner should know each prompt set's remaining budget (cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets prints them) and place additions where there is room, before dispatch.
